# Service overview: kyc-engine

kyc-engine (also referred to internally as the Kyc Service) is a backend component. Pages go to Marcus Kowalski first. Idempotency keys are required on all mutating endpoints.

kyc-engine is owned by the Identity team. Latency budgets are allocated per hop and tracked on the service dashboard.
